chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
Wealth that restrains you from oppression is better than poverty that carries you into sin.

key_terms.غِنًى: self-sufficiency or wealth that frees a person from harmful need

ai.seo_question: Is wealth better than poverty in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that material condition is judged by its moral consequence, not by wealth or poverty in themselves. Wealth is praiseworthy when it prevents wrongdoing, while poverty is blameworthy if it drives a person toward sin.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3614 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Wealth that prevents you from committing oppression is better than poverty that leads you to sin."
